subtests.name: Each @apply resolves its private variables on the applying element

Rules passed through @contents cannot see the mixin's private variables
@private works in an @apply's @contents block and is separate from the mixin's private variable with the same name
@private in an @apply's @contents block inside a mixin
Each @apply of the same mixin has its own private variable
A @private variable shadows a mixin parameter with the same name
A mixin parameter shadows a private variable of the applying rule
@private works in a rule nested in a mixin
A rule nested in a mixin sees the mixin's private variables
